name: Thetanuts BTC/USD covered-call vault first-depositor rounding
summary: The BTC/USD covered-call vault still held ~0.15 WBTC while its share totalSupply had fallen to zero, so a flash-loaned two-step deposit (2 satoshis, then 4.68 WBTC) rounded the attacker into effectively all outstanding shares and initWithdraw() redeemed the vault's whole WBTC balance.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
